description: Contains a snapshot of Dialogflow CX page configurations within a flow.

schema.name: runtime
schema.description: The timestamp when the data extraction process was run.

schema.name: run_guid
schema.description: A unique identifier for each execution run of the data extraction process.

schema.name: agent_project_id
schema.description: The Google Cloud project ID of the Dialogflow CX agent.

schema.name: agent_location_id
schema.description: The GCP region or location of the Dialogflow CX agent (e.g., 'us-central1').

schema.name: agent_id
schema.description: The unique identifier (UUID) for the Dialogflow CX agent.

schema.name: agent_name
schema.description: The human-readable display name of the Dialogflow CX agent.

schema.name: flow_id
schema.description: The unique identifier (UUID) for the parent Dialogflow CX flow.

schema.name: flow_name
schema.description: The human-readable display name of the parent Dialogflow CX flow.

schema.name: page_id
schema.description: The unique identifier (UUID) for the Dialogflow CX page.

schema.name: page_name
schema.description: The human-readable display name of the Dialogflow CX page.

schema.name: webhook_id
schema.description: The unique identifier of a webhook called by this page's fulfillment.

schema.name: webhook_name
schema.description: The display name of a webhook called by this page's fulfillment.

schema.name: webhook_tag
schema.description: The tag associated with a webhook call in this page's fulfillment.

schema.name: fulfillment
schema.description: A JSON string representing the fulfillment configuration, which defines the agent's response when the page is entered.

schema.name: partial_response
schema.description: Indicates if the fulfillment can send a partial response to the user.

schema.name: parameter_presets
schema.description: A list of parameters that are set when the user transitions to this page.

schema.name: description
schema.description: User-provided description for the page's purpose.

schema.name: page_settings
schema.description: A JSON string containing detailed configuration for the page, such as form parameters, entry fulfillment, and transition routes.
